forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9780'
+title: 'Qwen3.8-27B summarizer returns no text: its thinking uses the whole summary ceiling'
+---
+## What happens
+
+After ^9ax82gr removed the chat-template errors, the fact-retention tier on `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` (2026-09-22, `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests --filter CompactionEvaluationIntegrationTests --attachments-path <dir>`) gave, per seed, from the xcevalresult attachment:
+
+- 5 seeds: `the summarizer returned no text, so the compaction has no summary to store` (`SummarizationError.emptySummary`).
+- 2 seeds: `CancellationError` (the suite time limit `compactionEvalSubsetTimeLimitMinutes = 2` stopped the run).
+- 0 of 7 seeds measured.
+
+## Probable cause
+
+^35j2zfg set the call's output ceiling to the allowed summary size (`targetTokens` 418 in this tier, less the instructions). The 27B is a reasoning model. It spends that ceiling on its thinking block, and no answer text is left.
+
+## For the owner
+
+This needs the owner's decision. Do not add a number. The 2-minute suite limit also does not hold a 27B run of 7 seeds (about 20 s for each compaction call). ^jhb7x54 waits on the result. #compaction
\ No newline at end of file
